subject: Enquiry — Marina Quarter Tower B structural package
body:
Dear Ahmed,

Further to our award of Marina Quarter Tower B, please quote your best prices for the structural package per the attached BBS rev. 2: rebar B500B 16 mm approx. 520 t, 20 mm 310 t, 25 mm 180 t, 12 mm 95 t; sulphate resisting cement approx. 14,500 bags; bitumen membrane 4 mm 760 rolls.

Deliveries Oct 2026 to Jun 2027 following our pour sequence. Kindly also advise your best payment terms — other suppliers are offering 90 days.

We need your offer by 18 Sep latest.

Regards,
Imran Qureshi
Procurement Manager

to: Eng. Sultan Al Mehairi, Ramesh Iyer (Gulf Crest)
subject: Site visit — Tower B logistics
body:
Site visit at Marina Quarter Tower B with Eng. Sultan and Ramesh.
- Marina Quarter Properties gate rules: deliveries Mon–Sat 09:00–16:00 only, gate permit to be booked 48 h ahead, max 12 m flatbed.
- Laydown area is tight: max 2 trailers per day can be off-loaded.
- Pour sequence: raft mid/late Oct, podium Nov–Dec, typical floors Jan–Jun 2027.
- Sultan's priority is reliability — 'one missed raft delivery costs us more than any price difference'.
- Ramesh will send weekly call-off forecasts once the PO is placed.

subject: Call — steel price basis
body: Lina asked whether steel can be fixed for the whole project. Explained FA-GCB-2026 indexes rebar quarterly and that the mill has announced a Q4 base-price increase. Lina: 'our Board will not accept indexation on this package — budget is fixed'. Also raised 5% retention as standard on their subcontracts. Told her retention is not in our frame agreement.

subject: Quotation Q-2026-0918 — Marina Quarter Tower B
body:
Dear Imran,

Please find attached our quotation Q-2026-0918 for the Tower B structural package, total AED 3,418,340 excl. VAT.

- Rebar 16 mm AED 2,780/t, 20 mm 2,765, 25 mm 2,790, 12 mm 2,820
- SRC cement AED 18.90/bag; bitumen membrane 4 mm AED 94.00/roll
- Payment 60 days from invoice date as per our frame agreement
- Valid until 30 September 2026; steel prices valid for the quotation period, thereafter per the FA quarterly index
- Deliveries Mon–Sat 09:00–16:00 per Marina Quarter gate rules

Best regards,
Ahmed Soliman
Key Account Manager

subject: Pricing rationale for Q-2026-0918
body: Priced as a project package above FA Q3 rates (16 mm 2,780 vs FA 2,705) to cover 9-month phasing risk and the mill's Q4 base increase (+40/t from 1 Oct). Cement and membrane also at project rates. Need to align with Fadi before any concession.

subject: WhatsApp
body: أحمد صباح الخير، استلمنا العرض Q-2026-0918. بصراحة 2,780 للـ 16 ملم غالي واجد، في مورد ثاني عطانا 2,675 delivered. وبعدين الـ 60 يوم ما تمشي مع الإدارة، نحتاج 90 يوم. نقدر نلتقي الخميس في المكتب؟

to: Imran Qureshi, Lina Farouk, Eng. Sultan Al Mehairi (Gulf Crest)
subject: Meeting notes — Gulf Crest office, Tower B commercial terms
body:
Attendees: Imran Qureshi, Lina Farouk, Eng. Sultan Al Mehairi (GCB); Ahmed Soliman (RBM).

Customer requests:
1. 16 mm at AED 2,690/t and proportional reductions on other diameters.
2. Payment 90 days from delivery.
3. Prices fixed until project completion (Jun 2027).
4. 5% retention until handover.

RBM position: AS explained FA terms (60 days from invoice, quarterly steel index, no retention). AS indicated there may be room to move toward ~2,700 on 16 mm IF 60-day terms are kept and indexation stays. No commitment given — subject to internal approval.

Actions: AS to revert with RBM position by 29 Sep. GCB Board meeting 5 Oct.

subject: GCB Tower B — approval for 2,700 on 16 mm?
body:
Fadi,

GCB wants 2,690 on 16 mm, 90 days, fixed to Jun 2027 and 5% retention. Competitor at 2,675 delivered. I hinted we could look at ~2,700 if they keep 60 days. 2,700 is below FA Q4 (2,745) but well above cost + 4% (2,631). Can you approve 2,700 on 16 mm and the same discount on other diameters?

Ahmed

subject: RE: GCB Tower B — approval for 2,700 on 16 mm?
body:
Ahmed,

With the mill increase landing on 1 Oct I don't want to go below the FA Q4 rates on steel. Hold at FA Q4 (16 mm 2,745 etc.) and bring cement/membrane back to FA rates — our quote should never have been above the FA. On terms: we can consider 75 days only with credit-insurance cover, and only Priya can approve it. No fixed price beyond 31 Dec and no retention without an amendment.

Please don't commit anything in writing until we've spoken.

Fadi

subject: WhatsApp
body: Ahmed habibi any update on revised price?? Board meeting is on 5th, I need final numbers before that pls

subject: KAM reassignments effective 1 October
body:
Team,

Effective 1 October Ahmed moves to lead the new Infrastructure & Government Projects desk. His building-contractor accounts move to Rania: Gulf Crest Builders, Al Marsa Engineering, Najm Al Sahil, Desert Rose, Bayt Al Reef, Noor Al Waha, Qasr Al Sahra and Sharq Al Emarat. APCC, Saqr Al Noor, Coastline, Ras Al Marsa Precast, Sandstone, Two Seas and Al Seef stay with Ahmed.

Handover notes in the CRM by 2 October please — open quotes, commitments, risks.

Fadi

subject: Handover note — Gulf Crest Builders
body:
Rania — GCB handover:
- Tower B package quoted Q-2026-0918 (3.42M). Customer pushing on price and terms. Board meeting 5 Oct.
- Lulu Island tiles quoted Q-2026-0925, samples pending.
- Imran is the main contact, likes WhatsApp. Lina is tough on commercials.
- Rest is in the CRM. Call me if needed.

subject: Gulf Crest — credit hold on SO-26-11842
body:
Rania, Fadi,

SO-26-11842 (Tower A podium, 120 t 16 mm) took Gulf Crest's exposure to AED 2,102,350 against a limit of AED 2,000,000 — the order is on automatic credit hold. AED 148,320 is overdue 1–30 days. Faris Al Kindi has committed a payment of AED 412,000 on 15 Oct.

Note that Tower B (3.4M) is more than 50% of the current limit, so any award triggers a limit review under RBM-FIN-POL-04 before we accept the PO.

Nadia

subject: Draft PO GCB/PRC/MQ-TB/PO-0412 — Tower B
body:
Dear Ahmed,

Our Board approved the Tower B package yesterday. Please find attached our draft PO GCB/PRC/MQ-TB/PO-0412 rev. A at the prices agreed with you in our meeting of 24 Sep (16 mm 2,690 etc.), payment 90 days from delivery, prices fixed until 30 Jun 2027 and 5% retention as per our standard terms.

Kindly confirm by return so we can sign. First call-off expected mid-October for the raft.

Regards,
Imran
